audit.whatIsWrong: diff says FAV but diffRating says 8.5/10 and report[14] says 'Hard matchup', against an Emerald+ win rate of 58.48% over 1927 games.
audit.why: 58.48% is the highest figure in this slice. A 8.5/10 difficulty label on Olaf's best lane is simply wrong, and it contradicts the FAV token sitting next to it.
audit.corrected: diffRating to 4/10, with breakdown.difficulty and the final-rating line brought in line. The FAV token was already right.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Teemo four rows (1, 2, 3, 6 and 2+ items) while every single 'why' beside those rows describes Olaf winning — whys[0] opens 'You win first contact', whys[4] describes running him down at 6. But the packet chart and the already-audited mirror do not agree with each other either.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Olaf/Olaf/Olaf/Olaf/Olaf/Olaf/Skill. The mirror's own note says it set Teemo's side to Teemo/Teemo/Skill/Skill/Olaf/Skill/Skill off a 45.41% figure. Inverted, that mirror is Olaf/Olaf/Skill/Skill/Teemo/Skill/Skill — which contradicts the packet on six of seven rows and contradicts this page's prose on level 6.
audit.corrected: NOT CHANGED. Two authorities disagree and guessing would ship a wrong chart to a paying user; the question is recorded instead. Every other correction in this file is independent of the chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributed Teemo's move speed to his passive, said at level 6 he has 'no CC, no slow' to peel with, and named no Teemo ability (packet defect).
audit.why: The move speed is Move Quick (W, 14s); the passive is Guerrilla Warfare, which turns him INVISIBLE while standing still or moving in brush — never mentioned, though it is the reason an Olaf gets ambushed. And Noxious Trap slows: telling the reader nothing can peel them at 6 walks them straight into a mushroom. The one thing the page got right and the mirror confirms is that Blinding Dart blanks autos but not Reckless Swing.
audit.corrected: Named Guerrilla Warfare, Blinding Dart (7s, 680), Move Quick, Toxic Shot and Noxious Trap; moved the move speed to W; added the brush invisibility; replaced the 'no slow' claim with the mushroom slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero sequencing cues — nothing on the page said what to wait for before committing.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank, which makes the trade rule concrete instead of vague.
audit.corrected: The 7s number written into spikes[1], mid, early, dosFull[0] and the difficulty line.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] ('Build MR + dodge shrooms') and dosFull[2] ('Axe to slow him') both carried unrelated bodies.
audit.why: Neither told the reader how to do the thing in its heading.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Blinding Dart and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Blinding Dart's 7s cooldown and how disciplined you are.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Teemo carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Teemo carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.before: Blinds autos — but not your E or axe. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Blinds autos, but not your E or axe — 7s flat. Only engage once it is down.

edits.before: Land the axe slow on Teemo, walk the pickup for the reset, reave the true damage, and W-sustain whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Mercury's Treads and a Sterak's blunt Toxic Shot's poison; never chase across ground you have not seen him mushroom.

edits.before: Teemo wastes Blinding Dart — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Undertow is 9s flat, and picking the axe back up resets it outright.

edits.before: You win first contact — Q-slow into an auto, and your passive attack speed ramps as you take his poke while his blind only delays your autos, not your E.
edits.after: You win first contact — Q-slow into an auto, and Berserker Rage ramps as you take his poke, while Blinding Dart blanks autos but never Reckless Swing.

edits.before: You out-trade his poke with W-omnivamp healing the poison while your slows keep him pinned in E range.
edits.after: You out-trade his poke with Tough It Out's shield while your slows keep him pinned inside 325 for E.

edits.before: Ragnarok makes you unstoppable with no CC to peel you, and he has no dash — Q, E, and W run him down for the kill.
edits.after: Ragnarok covers his disables and he has no dash, so Q, E and W run him down — only Noxious Trap slows can save him.

edits.before: Q-slow into E true damage chunks him for half a bar through the blind, and his Q only blanks your autos, not your E.
edits.after: Q-slow into E true damage chunks him through the blind — Blinding Dart is 7s, so trade in the gap after he spends it.

edits.before: Ragnarok cleanses nothing he has but makes you unstoppable to chase — Q-slow, E true damage, W-omnivamp through his kite for the kill.
edits.after: Ragnarok does not clear the blind — keep it simple: Q-slow, Reckless Swing true damage, and swing through his kite for the kill.

edits.before: Teemo's blind (Q) only kills your autos — it does nothing to your E, which is point-blank guaranteed true damage. So the early game is about landing your own Q first: throw the axe to slow him, walk up, and E him for a true-damage chunk he can't poke back through. His passive move speed lets him kite, but a stuck Q-slow pins him in E range. Don't waste E chasing if your Q misses, and accept a little poison damage — your passive ramps your attack speed as he chips you, so you only get scarier.
edits.after: Blinding Dart only kills your autos — it does nothing to Reckless Swing, which is point-blank guaranteed true damage. So the early game is about landing your own Q first: throw the axe to slow him, walk up, and E him for a chunk he cannot poke back through. Blinding Dart is 7s flat, so the trade window is the gap right after he spends it. Move Quick lets him kite, but a stuck Q-slow pins him inside 325. And Guerrilla Warfare turns him invisible in brush, so never facecheck one.

edits.before: This is your takeover. Every trade is the same: Q to slow, E for true damage, W on for the omnivamp so you heal the poison and poke right back. His blind is the only thing he has and it can't stop your E. Pick the axe back up to refund the Q cooldown and re-slow him so he never escapes to kite range. At 6, Ragnarok makes you unstoppable — he can't peel you off with anything, no CC, no slow, and he has zero dash to create distance. Run him down on his blind cooldown.
edits.after: This is your takeover. Every trade is the same: Q to slow, E for true damage, W on for the shield so you eat the poison and swing right back. Blinding Dart is the only thing he has and it cannot stop your E. Pick the axe back up to refund the Q cooldown and re-slow him so he never escapes to kite range. At 6, Ragnarok covers his disables and he has no dash to create distance — the one thing that still peels you is standing in a Noxious Trap, so watch the ground. Run him down on the 7s blind cooldown.

edits.before: Eat the blind on autos but land E for guaranteed true damage his Q cannot negate
edits.after: Eat the blind on autos but land Reckless Swing — Blinding Dart cannot stop it

edits.before: Blind your autos with Q every trade so your passive ramp and W-omnivamp do nothing
edits.after: Blind your autos with Blinding Dart every trade so your attack-speed ramp does nothing

edits.before: Kite with passive move speed and E poison, staying out of Q range entirely
edits.after: Kite with Move Quick and Toxic Shot poison, staying outside your 1000 Q range

notes: The level chart is left untouched on purpose — see questionsForUser. report[2].t ('His early — survive to your spikes') and phases[0-2] currently tell a 58%-win-rate lane that it loses the first three levels, which is almost certainly wrong, but it cannot be fixed without deciding the packet-vs-mirror conflict first. Olaf's Undertow 'grounding' flag was ignored here as elsewhere: it is a parsing artifact from 'throws an axe into the ground'.
